ev.q: Part three of the Mafia crime saga - 1968, New Bordeaux, LA
If you are into the 1960s and sandbox games this is the game for you
A vast world ruled by the mob and detailed with the sights and sounds of the era
The world also has a lot of small details that make it look more alive
The music selection is nice and suits the time period
while listening to classics of the era
The graphics have some nice details, especially the facial animations
You will be driving around in amazing modeled cars
you have a wide choice of firearms to terrorize those who have taken from you
Choose your own play-style; brute force, blazing guns or stalk-and-kill tactics
Build a new criminal empire your way by deciding which lieutenants you reward, and which you betray
Everything feels repetitive, and the gameplay gets stale pretty quickly
painfully tedious and repetitive mission design
игра моментально скатывается в невыносимо унылый симулятор зачистки одинаковых сараев
but hollow and lifeless if you stare at any part of it too long
the gunplay is under baked and is frustrating at times
